message.content: While men and women each have distinct strengths, it’s beneficial for them to adhere strictly to traditional gender roles. Men should prioritize leadership and competition, whereas women should focus on maintaining harmony and care roles. Respecting these roles enhances societal stability and allows each gender to excel where they naturally fit.
